verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so shipping official SDKs is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents an official MCP server, native integrations and an llms.txt help index. None of these is an official SDK, and evidence for other stories does not transfer here. No SDK, client library or developer API documentation appears in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
